scripts.text:
[Representative]
Welcome to ^8B4513Luoyang^000000,
an ancient land with
a history full of tales
of bravery.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
歡迎來到^8B4513龍之城^000000。
這片古老的土地，流傳著許多英雄傳說。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We now provide an ocean lane to accomodate foreign travelers and intercultural exchange from which all can benefit.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
如今我們開通了海上航線，方便外來旅客往來，促進文化交流，讓各方受益。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
^8B4513Luoyang^000000 is famous for
its elaborate history, as well as specialties that are unique to this nation. Please take your time and enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^8B4513龍之城^000000以悠久的歷史和獨有的物產聞名。
請慢慢遊覽，盡興而歸。

The {0} is located at ^0A82FF+^000000. It is where all the nobles reside, including our lord.
Since you're an outsider, I guess it would be appropriate for you to visit our lord first.
{1}

{0}位於^0A82FF+^000000處，領主和其他貴族都住在那裡。
您是遠道而來的客人，最好先去拜見領主。
{1}

[代表]
這家{0}很有名，聽說能包治百病。
不過，我也不知是真是假。
{1}

you should talk with the
employees there.

Knowing your enemy

[Representative]
When you get tired during your trip, I suggest that you visit the {0}. It's located at ^00FF00+^000000.

The Tavern is a good place

{0}
